comparison.objective: Join a cemented PVC pipe and tee using insertion, a quarter turn, and a timed hold; candidate breaks and recovers insert tangs.
comparison.physical_skill: Bimanual socket alignment, full-depth insertion, twisting, and sustained anti-pushout force versus mandrel alignment, hammer impact, safe withdrawal, and fragment retrieval.
comparison.success_condition: Assemble within 15 seconds and hold for 30 seconds after a quarter turn versus four notch fractures with intact inserts and all tangs contained.
comparison.reason: This is a genuine precision assembly neighbor, but interference/socket joining and timed holding test a materially different ability and terminal outcome from fracture finishing.
